newsitem.title: USA: KCBT wheat closes mixed, Dec premium widens.
newsitem.headline: KCBT wheat closes mixed, Dec premium widens.

text.p: KCBT hard red winter closed mixed with profit-taking on the December/March spread the main feature, floor sources said.
"We got 2-1/2 cents back on the inverse after taking a nickel out of it yesterday," one floor trader said.

December had weakened sharply late Wednesday with the fall partly triggered by talk that Egypt may have either cancelled or rejected a cargo of U.S. wheat. There were subsequent indications the rumors were probably unfounded.
The first month ended 1/4 cent up at $4.32-1/2 with March 2-1/2 cents easier at $4.20-1/2.
The market also derived some support from slightly stronger than expected weekly U.S. export sales data.
Other months finished four to one cents higher.
